title: Wraith-Hunter's Cache
description: A cache of supplies lies half-buried beneath a collapsed wall, its leather wrappings stamped with the crossed-lantern sigil of the wraith-hunters' guild. Fading ward-glyphs flicker across its surface, their protective magic nearly spent. Whoever stashed these supplies never returned to claim them.

choices.label: Break the wards
choices.description: The wards are weak enough to crack — coin and supplies wait inside.

choices.label: Collect the soul ore
choices.description: Wraith-hunters always carry soul ore for ammunition and wards.

choices.label: Gather the deadman's grass
choices.description: Bundles of dried deadman's grass are packed alongside the other supplies.

choices.label: Leave the cache
choices.description: Those wards were placed for a reason.
